preconditions.description: L and R must be positive integers within the specified bounds.
L must be less than or equal to R.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(n) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{t_i} {c_i}' for t_i, c_i in blocks)
postconditions.description: The output must consist of the number of blocks followed by the block details in the specified format.

postconditions.expression: all(t_i >= 0 and c_i >= 1 for t_i, c_i in blocks)
postconditions.description: Each block must have a non-negative level number and a positive count.

postconditions.expression: sum(c_i for t_i, c_i in blocks) == m
postconditions.description: The total count of all blocks must equal the number of segments in the decomposition.
